newsitem.title: USA: Mesaba Airlines June load factor rises.
newsitem.headline: Mesaba Airlines June load factor rises.

text.p: Mesaba Airlines, operating as Northwest Airlink, said Monday its June passenger load factor rose 0.9 points year over year to 57.4 percent.

Revenue passenger miles increased 45.9 percent to $54.0 million from 37.0 million in June of 1996. Available seat miles advanced 43.7 percent to 94.0 million from 65.4 million in the prior year, the carrier said in a news release.
Mesaba Holdings Inc, the parent company of Mesaba Airlines, operates as a Northwest Airlink affiliate under code-sharing agreements with Northwest Airlines Corp.
Currently, Mesaba Airlines serves 67 cities in 16 states and Canada from its two hubs at Minneapolis/St. Paul and Detroit Metro International Airports.
